sources.india_context: jobcode.in aggregation: 'BJAK is hiring talented Backend Developers across India to develop the core backend infrastructure powering its AI-driven Neobank platform'

facts: Bjak (BJAK Sdn. Bhd.) is a technology company making financial services transparent, efficient, and inclusive; started in 2019; headquartered in Malaysia; BNM-approved Financial Adviser and Islamic Financial Adviser (Bank Negara Malaysia).

Built the first mobile-first insurance platform in the region; today the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia, serving over 9 million users; also an approved vehicle-insurance platform digitizing road tax renewals.
Expanding into spending, saving, investing, exchanging, and travel; building BJAK's AI Neobank app.
More than 20 nationalities across offices and remote roles; remote hiring per market (the India listing says candidates must be based in India).
Interview process: online assessment or practical task, then technical interview, then CEO/final round; aim to complete within 1 week for strong candidates; fast assessment completion is prioritized.
Posting bands the role at 12-18 LPA (posting fact only; never claim in letters).

Posting requirements: strong backend engineering experience in production systems; good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations; services used by real customers at meaningful scale; debugging, reliability, security, data-quality mindset; practical trade-offs.

Posting scope: backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows; integrating internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms; reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity, incident handling.
Posting explicitly says fintech/payments/KYC/fraud experience is a strong plus but not required if fundamentals are strong.
claims_forbidden: any specific language/framework for Bjak's stack (the posting names no language; never claim or refer to Laravel/PHP)
